scenes.img: Over-the-shoulder view from behind the Korean mother of the bride seated at a small consultation table in a calm makeup studio; on the table an open notebook and a few hanbok fabric swatches.
scenes.m: Her hand slowly turns one page of the notebook, then rests; one action only, five natural fingers.

scenes.img: Close back view of the woman seated, her neat low chignon and the nape of her neck, soft studio light, cream curtains.
Still life: an empty makeup station at early morning — brushes in a cup, a round wall clock showing 6 o'clock, soft dawn light, a sense of hurry.
Over-the-shoulder close-up from behind the same woman: her own hand rests on several hairstyle sketches and a makeup face chart spread on the table.
scenes.m: Her hand slowly slides one hairstyle sketch closer, then rests; one action only, five natural fingers.

scenes.img: Still life: hanbok fabric swatches fanned out on a cream table — soft pink, jade green, pale blue and navy silk — beside a small notebook.
Back view of the same woman seated calmly at the consultation table with a cup of tea, relaxed shoulders, soft window light.
Still life: a desk calendar with one date circled, a small hanbok sketch and a pencil beside it, soft light.
Wide view of an empty Korean wedding hall entrance in the morning, tall doors half open, flower stands, no people.
Still life: an open client notebook with neat handwritten notes, a small updo sketch and a pencil, soft light.
Back view of the same woman standing at the open doors of a bright Korean wedding hall, about to walk in, warm light ahead.
scenes.m: She walks slowly forward through the doors into the warm light, skirt sways gently; she never turns.

p2-05.title: 혼주 머리, 미리 해 보면 달라질까?

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated in a salon chair, her dark brown hair still loose to the shoulders, comb and pins on the counter, soft light, no mirror visible.
scenes.m: She gently lifts her loose hair at the nape with one hand, then lowers it; one action only.

scenes.img: Close back view of the same woman's finished elegant low chignon with a small pearl dwikkoji, pale pink jeogori collar.
Close top-back view of the same woman's hair being sectioned: a clean side parting line and soft crown volume, tail comb resting in the hair, no hands.
Back view of the same woman in the salon chair with her finished low chignon, pale pink jeogori, warm studio light.
scenes.m: An extremely slow push-in toward the finished chignon; soft light glints on the hair. She stays perfectly still.

scenes.img: Quiet bedroom at night: a pale pink hanbok on a stand by the window, moonlight, a small bedside lamp, no people.
Back view of the same woman seated in the salon chair, relaxed shoulders, holding a cup of tea, calm.
Back view of the same woman standing up from the salon chair, finished chignon, about to walk toward a bright doorway.
scenes.m: She walks slowly toward the bright doorway, skirt sways gently; she never turns.

p3-15.hook:
눈물 날 것 같은데,
화장 괜찮을까?
p3-15.title: 결혼식 날 눈물, 화장 괜찮을까?

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated in a bridal waiting room, holding a folded white handkerchief in her lap, soft light.
scenes.m: Her fingers slowly tighten around the white handkerchief, then relax; one small action only.

scenes.img: Empty Korean wedding hall aisle with white flowers and softly glowing candles, gentle light, no people.
Still life: waterproof mascara, slim eyeliner pencil and fine makeup brushes laid on cream linen, soft light.
Still life: an open eyeshadow palette in soft browns, a small eyelash curler and cotton swabs on cream linen.
Macro still life: a fine eyeliner brush touching matte setting powder in a small compact, soft light.
Over-the-shoulder close-up from behind the same woman: her hand holds a folded white gauze handkerchief at the cuff of her pale pink jeogori sleeve.
scenes.m: Her hand slowly tucks the folded handkerchief into the jeogori sleeve, then rests; one action only, five natural fingers.

scenes.img: Back view of the same woman standing at the front of the wedding hall, soft candlelight ahead, calm posture.
Back view of the same woman standing in warm light in the wedding hall, white flowers around, peaceful.
scenes.m: Her shoulders gently relax, a few flower petals drift down slowly in the light; she never turns.

p4-07.title: 얼굴이 둥근 혼주님, 이 머리 하세요

scenes.img: Back view of the Korean mother of the bride seated in a salon chair, elegant updo, pale pink jeogori, soft light, no mirror visible.
scenes.m: An extremely slow push-in toward her updo; soft light glints on the hair. She stays perfectly still.

scenes.img: Still life: a tail comb, hair pins and a small round hand mirror lying face down on a salon counter, soft light.
Back view of the same woman's updo with soft lifted volume at the crown, pale pink jeogori collar.
Close back view of the same woman's crown: one hand (natural nails, no rings) holds a tail comb lifting a small section of hair at the top of the head.
scenes.m: The hand slowly lifts the section with the tail comb to add volume, then rests; one action only, five natural fingers.

scenes.img: Back view silhouette of the same woman against a bright window, her updo tall and elegant at the crown, slender line.
Close back view of the same woman: the hair at the sides above the ears smoothed flat and sleek, volume only at the top, low chignon.
Back view of the same woman walking down a bright Korean wedding hall aisle, tall elegant updo, white flowers.
scenes.m: She walks slowly away from the camera, skirt sways gently, candle flames flicker; she never turns.

p5-13.title: 혼주 한복에 귀걸이, 아무거나 하면 안 돼요

scenes.img: Macro still life: a pair of white pearl drop earrings with small crystals resting on cream velvet inside a lacquered box, soft window light.
scenes.m: A soft light sweep glides slowly across the pearls; the earrings stay still. Static camera.

scenes.img: Close view from behind and slightly to the side of the same woman: her ear with a white pearl drop earring, low chignon, pale pink jeogori collar; her face is not visible.
Still life: white pearl earrings resting on the gentle curve of pale pink hanbok silk.
Still life: ivory pearl earrings with a ring of tiny crystals in front, a pair of black pearl earrings set aside at the back, cream cloth.
Close back view of the same woman's nape and the white dongjeong collar of her pale pink jeogori rising at the neck, no necklace, low chignon.
scenes.m: An extremely slow push-in toward the white collar; soft light moves across the silk. She stays perfectly still.

scenes.img: Close-up of one hand (natural nails) wearing a pale jade ring resting on a deep magenta hanbok skirt.
scenes.m: The fingers move slightly and the jade ring catches the light; one small action only, five natural fingers.

scenes.img: Still life: a pearl necklace laid aside next to a neatly folded pale pink hanbok and a small ring tray, soft light.
